source_caption:
Funniest film of the year.

Olivia Wilde's comedy-drama film The Invite follows a couple who host their loud upstairs neighbors for a tense, awkward dinner party. It is based on Cesc Gay’s stage play The People Upstairs and features background details from its troubled development to specific filming choices. The movie sparked a major bidding war after premiering at the Sundance Film Festival, with A24 acquiring the distribution rights for over $12 million.Seth Rogen and Olivia Wilde nailed it with their expressions in this film.

source_details.title: The Invite
source_details.synopsis: The Invite is a 2026 American sex comedy drama film directed by Olivia Wilde from a screenplay by Will McCormack and Rashida Jones. It is an English-language remake of the 2020 Spanish film The People Upstairs (Sentimental) by Cesc Gay. The film stars Seth Rogen, Wilde, Penélope Cruz, and Edward Norton. The film premiered at the Eccles Theater as a part of the 2026 Sundance Film Festival on January 24, receiving positive reviews. It received a limited release in the United States on June 26, before opening wide on July 10, by A24, and has grossed $59.9 million worldwide.
